messages.en: What are you doing!!
No,
The Beautiful Girl of Destiny ㄹㅋㄹㅋㄹㅋㄹㅋㄹㅋ
I saw it,
it came up in the middle of filming,
so I watched it with the members,
and got my fill of being mocked.
No, but
even I thought
my face looked like it was about to burst.
The Hexagon who reassured me that I didn't need to lose weight even in that state
Hexagon ….you're too much.
It's seriously legendary.
Even I can't watch the whole thing.
Was I pretty? First love??
I really thought I'd only be in it briefly too,
but I was in it for so long,
I was like, wow, you're really using all of this???
I was watching while going, "Stop!!!!"
I watch it ㅋㅅㅋㄹㅋㅋ

messages.ko: 찍을 때 현타 안 왔어..?? 저런 걸 어떻게 찍은 거야
messages.en: Didn't you get hit with reality while filming..?? How did you even film something like that?
I really got hit with reality,
and every now and then
I'd go, "Ah… just a moment…."
and then
"I can do this!!! You're doing well!!!"
It kept repeating.
It was nice to act for the first time in a while,
but I didn't know I'd be showing you acting like this.
I had no idea.
I feel like compared to the other members,
my lines were more difficult..
I feel like I sang, danced, and did everything..
Now, do not bring that up in front of me.
I can't believe I created my own embarrassing history.
흙흙흙ㄱ
I heard you played Roblox yesterday.
Oh right ㅋㅎㅋㅋㅋ
During our waiting time,
I played with the members,
and as expected, games played during waiting time
are the most fun.
We played something like Russian roulette,
something like that,
I was winning,
but I had to go film, and when I came back out,
I was dead.
I heard Nien pushed you while you were playing Red Light, Green Light in Squid Game ㅋㅋㅋㅋㅋ
No, exactlyㄹㅋㄹㅋㅋㅋ
She suddenly pushed me,
so I died as soon as it started
and could only spectate YeonJi.
Nien unnie, even in Roblox,
you're fighting with physical strength.
Even in Roblox, Hayeon's a dead person.
Don't.
I'm gonna cry.
I'm done spectating…
I was still in the ace position though.
This Badge War has reduced me to this!!!
If you laugh like that in text! You might think it'll get under my skin,
but it did.
Honestly,

messages.ko: 이범 배전 하기전에 내 큰 꿈은
messages.en: before this Badge War, my big dream was
to get picked as the spy,
actually fool everyone and take first place,
and cement my title as the Badge War villain,
but I never imagined I'd so innocently become a reaction-rich dead person.
I never dreamed it'd turn out this way.
But actually,
in Season 3, since I was a contender to win,
until filming ended,

messages.ko: 무슨 게임을 할지 어떻게해야 이길지 생각하느라
messages.en: I kept thinking about what games we'd play and how I could win,
so it was tiring having to constantly worry about it,
but this time, while everyone was staying up all night to investigate,
I could sleep peacefully,
so it was definitely nice.
That was the positive spin I was putting on it.
Didn't the dead people investigate too?
That's true.
Whenever I lay down to sleep,
one by one they'd come to me
"Who do you think it is??"

messages.ko: 나는 누구인거같아. 이유는 몰라 내 감이야 무조건
messages.en: "Who do you think I am? I don't know why, it's just my gut feeling, definitely."
I thought it was DaHyun unnie….
I thought it was definitely SeoAh or DaHyun.
And Yooyeon unnie seemed suspicious too,
so I said, "I think it's Yooyeon unnie~?"
but thinking about it, in the room,
JooBin had been Yooyeon-lighting everyone.
I thought it was Yooyeon unnie.
So I thought that too,
but this ungrateful JooBin
turned out to be the spy.
With instincts this bad, you'd probably have trolled even if you were alive.
Hayeon got played by Bini.
And Soomin's belly got bigger.
That scene was so funny.

messages.ko: 내 속마음을 어케 아시고 자막 다신거지
messages.en: How did they know exactly what I was thinking and put that subtitle in?
I wanted to investigate a little and look cool,

messages.ko: 내가 놀아난거 같은데? 쟤가 스파이고 뭐 누구는 뭐고 이런
messages.en: "I feel like I got played? She's the spy, and so-and-so is this and that,"
I wanted a scene like that when I started talking,
but when they said my belly got bigger,
I was completely deflated,
and thought, "What am I even saying…"
That's what I thought, but then
they literally put the exact same thing in the subtitles.

messages.ko: 망자들 위에서 계속 과자 먹고있던데 과자는 자꾸 어디서 나온고야
messages.en: You kept eating snacks while lying above the dead people, where did you keep getting them from?
Snacks JiWoo unnie brought ㅋㄹㅋㄹㅋㅋ
The spy's snacks really were something else.
They were a little more substantial~
Did you get sleepy and fall asleep after eating that??
No.
Soomin drained my energy,
and I got hit with sleepiness.
The magical girl episode came out today too,
I guess I'm an adult now.
How many cocktails am I making?
The one I made definitely would've tasted better.
Are you underestimating the power of magic?
Let's do something like that sometime too.
Ah, we have so much to do.
I'll be the bartender,
we'll open something like a trading thing,
and I'll make everyone a cocktail.
Then minors can't go…
Minors can drink grape juice.
We could make it a full-on wav party like this,
like those parties abroad,
with everyone coming dressed in suits and dresses.
That'd be so much fun.
We could add random draws too,
and the winner gets
100 Objekt!!
ㅋㄹㅋㄹㄹㅋㄹㅋㅋㅋㅋ
I'm so busy today, busy busy.
I've had schedules from this morning until now,
and I have lessons starting at 1.
Give me some words of encouragement.
Tell me I'm doing well.
Tell me.
It really gives me strength.
I can't live without Y/n~~
Can you live without me…?
I asked if I was pretty!!! First love!!!
흥
I took lots of pictures yesterday.
I'll send them after the concert.
I'm happy that I finally have pictures to send you.
And when we have the concert, I'll have to send you the pictures I take there too,
so there are a lot.
I haven't eaten a single meal.
What should I eat?
I'm feeling tteokbokki today.
Tteokbokki sounds good.
I'll get rosé with extra glass noodles
and make it super thick and creamy.
I should find someone to eat with.
Y/n, want to eat together~?
Where should we meet~?
Give me your address~~
No, seriously,
someone's even giving me their apartment numberㅇ
ㅋㄹㅋㄹㅋㄹㅋㄹㅋㄹㅋㅋ
What would you do if I actually went?
That's dangerous~
Don't do that to other women.
I guess all women are wolves..
ㅋㅎㅋㅎㅋㄹㅋㅎㅋㅋㅋㅋ
Except me, I mean!!! You should only trust me!!!
Awooooo~~~~~~~
I'm the wolf and you're the beauty!
This song,
I think I almost covered it,
or maybe not.
I love you~
ㅋㄹㅋㄹㅋㄹㅋㅋㅋ
Maybe I won't do any more boy group songs
is what I was about to say,
but 'Replay' is still left.
Look forward to it.
Kim ChaeWon
doing 'Cheer Up'
I can already imagine how annoying she's going to make it.
That smug little expression is definitely going to come out.
Don't you think Chaewon probably thinks the same thing about Hayeon?
She'd probably be like, "She's pretending to be handsome again."
ㅋㄹㅋㄹㅋㄹㅋㄹㅋㄹㅋㅋ
No, but
she often tells me I'm handsome.
Do you often tell Chaewon she's cute or pretty??
I don't give
anyone any kind of evaluation.

messages.ko: 근데 진짜 이쁜 날이거나 그럼 말해주고
messages.en: But if it's really a day when they're pretty, I'll tell them,

messages.ko: 나한테 오늘 어떠냐 물어보면 말 해줌
messages.en: and if they ask me how they look that day, I'll tell them.

messages.ko: 그럼 하연이가 예쁘다 하면 진짜 예쁜거네
messages.en: Then if Hayeon says someone is pretty, they must really be pretty.
Exactly.
I can't just give empty compliments.
I think the members are always pretty,
so I think it to myself,
"Wow, you're really pretty today?"
I only say it when it's too pretty to keep to myself.
ㅋㄹㅋㄹㅋㄹㅋㄹㅋㅎㅋ
But when I really like someone,
I don't keep it just to myself.
Like I do with Y/n,
I don't have time to hold back my expressions with Y/n.
I want to tell you everything,
because really,
even just to always be happy,
our time is too short ㅠㅠ
I'm always grateful and I love you~Y/n
I really can't think of anything except how grateful I am.
When I think about it,
the one who was always with me through the hard times and happy times
was Y/n.
Really,
thank you.
What could there be that's more than saying thank you?
Saying you love me is enough.
I love you~
But now, saying things like this
doesn't even feel cringey anymore,
because it's just something I always
think about.
Even my family always
tells me to treat Y/n well,
and every time on the phone,
ㅋㄹㅋㄹㅋㄹㅋㄹㅋㄹㅋ
That was a little Yukrang time.
Shall we have Harang time now?
Yeah, Haranghae~~
Captain, are you thinking of changing your profile picture?
I'll consider it.
Good night~~
Sleep well.
Haranghae😍😍
